evidence: Every rejects/hides/absent/unchanged leg in the frozen criteria is paired, inside the same criterion, with a matching success case, and the functional prompt states it globally: tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:16 'A positive control must come before every negative claim. If the control cannot be performed, the criterion fails rather than passing on absence of evidence.' Per-criterion pairings in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml: cw_format_error_keeps_draft (line 209 valid compact draft must format first; 'Fails ... if the valid control did not format'); cw_error_message_and_line (236 valid .js control run); cw_promise_rejection_message_and_line (245 handled-catch control); cw_run_starts_fresh_document (263 first run must report property defined); cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget (281 first button's delayed marker); cw_time_limit_recovery (299 short-timer control); cw_stop_cancels_pending_work (308 control marker via timer/interval/Promise must appear; 'Fails ... if the control marker never appeared'); cw_newer_run_supersedes (317 delayed control marker); cw_preview_isolation (326 saved snippet, health load, localStorage set/read, own-preview DOM+console as controls; silent probe = fail); cw_dynamic_code_refused (335 harmless string/comment mention must run); cw_stale_save_refused (353 A's accepted save); cw_stale_save_keeps_draft (362 confirmed refusal + typing still edits B); cw_restore_request_repeat_safe (380 first restore must add revision 3, request must be seen and sent); cw_history_restore_adds_revision (371 inspect/restore must work before the 'still listed' check); cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state (398 'If A's library never shows B's snippet, this criterion fails'); cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft (407 baseline no-notice then notice must appear); find/replace/multi-caret 'nowhere else'/'near-match unchanged' legs are paired with required positive hits (137, 146, 155, 101, 119); cw_caret_navigation 'moves change the source' paired with required moves (38). Polish: cw_undo_redo_availability (50) disabled states paired with 'Undo becomes available'/'Redo becomes available' and 'Fails ... if the app has no visible Undo and Redo controls'; cw_unsaved_marker (59) clean-state absence paired with indicator appearing after edit; cw_narrow_width_usable (68) no-sideways-scroll paired with reach/typing/Run. Visual likerts anchor 0 to 'not shown'. Constraints gate cw_shared_saved_record is a positive save/readback. Broken-app trial: a blank page or static shell fails the render gate (render judge.toml:23 'no code editing area' fails) and every scored prompt's global browser gate zeroes the dimension (functional prompt.md:5, polish :40, visual :64); score.py:41-48 returns reward 0 unless both gates pass and functional exceeds its 0.05 floor (scoring.toml floors), and every functional criterion requires a positive action, so a dead app cannot earn reward from any negative-only leg. Conforming-alternative trial: controls are outcome-based (any status wording, either modifier-click, Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z, static restored picture allowed), so a correct app is not failed by the control requirements. Residual observations (not defects): (a) constraints cw_custom_document_surface (constraints judge.toml:23) is mostly a negative DOM check and its fallback 'inspect where the source already shown in the editor is displayed' lets a non-editable display pass that gate, but it is a zero-weight gate whose only purpose is the constraint, editing is graded positively in functional, and render gate + functional floor exclude dead apps; (b) polish cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus (polish judge.toml:23) excludes absent/disabled controls, so an app missing controls is not penalized there by design ('scored elsewhere'), and it still needs reachable controls with visible focus. Runtime: scripted golden results re-hashed (runtime.json 4fd9dd5b..., polish.json 3701e316... match the index); v15 hosted nop scored 0, but no configured-judge run exists on these v16 bytes, so per-criterion control behaviour of the LLM judge on v16 is NOT EXERCISED; that missing measurement belongs to the runtime/discrimination rows and is not waived here.
